title: Recommendation of 800 would overstock: modify to 240
description: The replenishment system recommends 800 units of Leche Alquería 1L for Chapinero. The agent's own requirement is far lower and 800 breaks storage, budget, case pack and the 10-day cover limit for chilled dairy.
rationale: horizon = lead time 3 (SUP-ALQ) + review period 2 = 5 days
demand = 60/day x 5 = 300; safety stock = 2 safety days x 60 = 120
available = on_hand 180 - reserved 20 = 160; inbound = PO-1001 120 confirmed, arriving day 2 (inside horizon)
order = max(140, MOQ 240) = 240, already a multiple of case pack 12 -> 240
projection without order (end of day): d0 160-60=100, d1 40, d2 40+120-60=100, d3 40, d4 -20 -> stockout on day 4 without action
new order arrives day 3 (lead 3): level before arrival = end of day 2 = 100
storage: chilled capacity 2000, used 1400 of which 180 is this SKU -> other SKUs 1220; free at arrival = 2000 - 1220 - 100 = 680 -> max 672 (floor to 12)
cover limit 10 days x 60 = 600 units at arrival -> max order 600 - 100 = 500 -> 492 (floor to 12)
240 passes everything: value 1,008,000 COP < auto-approve threshold 3,000,000 -> executes without approval
after confirmation: d3 100+240-60=280, d4 220; minimum level 40 >= 0, cover at arrival 340/60 = 5.67 <= 10 -> outcome check passes
